summary: The D-01 route now matches the approved writing-workspace intent closely enough for this audit: the screen has a branded product sidebar, page-level command/status row, autosave and timer indicators, dominant submit CTA, 3-step writing progress row, q51 blank tabs, blank-aware answer editor, expression hints, reference material, and right-side AI tutor/support guidance. Authenticated 360/768/1280 captures render on the target route with no console errors or Next error overlay.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: hifi shows a branded product sidebar with icon navigation, study encouragement, profile state, and writing flow context.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: the workspace now uses a branded TALKPIK AI sidebar with icon navigation, selected writing context, profile-visible global header, and a study encouragement panel.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned for audit scope; remaining global header differences are shell-level styling choices, not a D-01 blocker.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: the writing screen now reads as a product workspace instead of a generic menu shell.
comparisonSummary.nextAction: retain current sidebar treatment and monitor shared-shell consistency in future shell-wide audits.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: hifi puts the screen title, autosave status, timer, bookmark/save, and submit CTA in the first-row command area.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: the D-01 workspace now presents a page-level h1, subtitle, autosave status, timer, secondary temporary-save action, and primary submit CTA in the command card.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; status and submit are visible before the learner reaches the editor body.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: learners can immediately identify the task, save state, elapsed time, and next action.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: wireframe/hifi make problem reading and answer writing the dominant central task, with a clear stepper.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: the route now shows a 3-step progress row, prominent prompt card, reference card, q51 blank tabs, and a dominant answer editor.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; task hierarchy and workflow progress are explicit across desktop, tablet, and mobile captures.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: learners can see where they are in the writing flow and move from reading to answer composition without ambiguity.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: wireframe reserves a distinct support/material region; hifi integrates AI tutor guide and supporting cards on the right.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: reference material remains close to the prompt, while the right/support region now contains AI tutor guidance, writing tips, example answer hints, and review action.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; support is clearly grouped and connected to the blank-answer task.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: learners can find task context and answer guidance without leaving the first writing workspace.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: hifi shows blank tabs, a labeled answer card, large answer input, and expression-hint chips directly tied to the blank.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: the q51 route now provides blank tabs from normalized blank data, a labeled blank-answer editor, character progress, large TextArea, and expression-hint chips.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned for the q51 blank-writing interaction.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: learners receive immediate blank-specific context and composition scaffolding.

comparisonSummary.area: progress, word count, and state indicators
comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: autosave and progress are prominent in the header and step row.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: autosave is promoted to the command row, elapsed time is visible, the current step is shown in the progress row, and the answer card keeps character progress next to the TextArea.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; page-level and editor-level state are both visible.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: learners can check saving/progress state without scanning deep into the editor.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: submit is the dominant top-right CTA; save/bookmark are secondary.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: submit is now the dominant command-row CTA on desktop/tablet/mobile, with temporary save as a secondary command.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; the next action is immediately scannable.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: submission remains available and visually prioritized while validation behavior is preserved.

comparisonSummary.referenceIntent: mobile should preserve primary task visibility, CTA clarity, and no overflow.
comparisonSummary.currentImplementation: 360/768/1280 captures render on the target route with no horizontal overflow observed, no login bounce after auth storage, no console errors, and no Next error overlay.
comparisonSummary.delta: aligned; desktop uses a two-column workspace and tablet/mobile stack cleanly.
comparisonSummary.userImpact: the screen is usable and visually stable across the audited breakpoints.
comparisonSummary.nextAction: keep the current responsive stacking as the q51 baseline.
